children: Previously unreleased early recordings by David Bowie will be available to buy and stream from Friday, including five songs found by music historian Alec Palao and five more tracks he later obtained, BBC reported. The material forms part of a new posthumous album, The Shel Talmy Recordings, which also includes demos and remastered songs. Six of the unreleased tracks will be issued on vinyl, with a limited edition sold at Record Store Day and HMV outlets. Bowie’s estate licensed the album to Warner Music Group subsidiary Parlophone, and royalties will be paid to the estate.

title: Early Bowie Music Available to Stream for First Time
